geography: World Bank countries and economies with a non-aggregate region and at least one published value in the series. Codes follow the World Bank registry, including XKX for Kosovo.
transformations: Rows are grouped under their source economy codes. All years within the observed series span appear. Null in JSON and blank in CSV represent an unavailable observation. Numeric values retain the precision returned by the publisher. Explicit zeros and status codes are retained.
validation: Each observation from the API for every non-aggregate economy, including unavailable years, was checked for equality with its entry in the separately downloaded official wide CSV release.

industrial-value-added.name: Industry (including construction), value added (constant 2015 US$)
industrial-value-added.definition: Industry (including construction) corresponds to ISIC (Rev.4) divisions 05-43. It is comprised of mining, manufacturing, construction, electricity, water, and gas industries. Value added is the contribution to the economy by a producer or an industry or an institutional sector, which is estimated by the total value of output produced and deducting the total value of intermediate consumption of goods and services used to produce that output. This indicator is expressed in constant prices, meaning the series has been adjusted to account for price changes over time. The reference year for this adjustment is 2015. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.

methodology.source: World Bank World Development Indicators, national accounts.
methodology.interpretation: Real industrial value added includes mining, manufacturing, utilities and construction. It measures output after intermediate inputs, in constant 2015 US dollars.
